summary: PT Telkom Indonesia filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing the summary of minutes of its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held September 30, 2026, 16.45-17.22 Western Indonesia Time, conducted online via KSEI's eASY.KSEI system. Shareholders representing 86,917,778,519 shares, or 88.1689481% of voting shares after treasury stock, satisfied quorum under OJK Regulation No. 15/POJK.04/2020; PT Datindo Entrycom validated votes. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation. Watch for the resolutions' substance in forthcoming disclosure.
